content_zh:
龙大耀双手一动，一拳袭击来。
“呼，呼……”
拳头生风，八级战师的力量全部爆发出来。
龙飞并不惧，身体一扑，趴在地上变成一只大蛤蟆，十成功力释放，身上的劲气卷起，就如气浪一般弹开。
四肢一动。
“嗡！”
身体弹了出去，黑影如同闪电，划破一切，朝龙大耀冲上去。
在这同时。
他体内的真气催动。
“哼！”
“废物就是废物，半年不见，你还是废物，还妄想跟我动手，找死！”龙大耀鄙夷一声，双拳成掌。
虚空拍出。
两道力量形成劲气，扑向龙飞。
“砰，砰！”
龙飞硬抗，直接将两道力量给冲破掉，狠狠的撞在龙大耀的腹部。
龙大耀双手拼命顶住。
“绞杀！”
蛤蟆功的力量骤然剧变，以螺旋似的旋转进入龙大耀的体内，龙飞也顺势一弹，往后飞了出去。
“嗡！”
龙大耀体内发出一声沉闷的撞击声，脸色暗自一狞，露出痛苦的表情，“狗东西，神级功法？”

“噗……”
吐出一口黑血，脸上的阴冷表情也显得更为狰狞。
龙飞冷笑道：“爽吧！”
“狗东西，你以为修炼了神级功法就是我的对手？”龙大耀的声音突然变了，身上一团黑色的煞气弥散出来。
“魔功？”
“你是魔宗的人？”龙飞心神一凛，他现在总算知道这龙大耀为何要监视他，并且一直在找他。
他开始以为这是龙战武的安排。
现在看来完全不是，这龙大耀一定是邪魔宗门潜伏在龙家的，为什么抓自己？
至于这点，龙飞还没有想明白。
龙大耀阴沉沉的笑了起来，道：“不愧是龙家昔日天才，还算有点见识，现在怕了吧，跪下磕头求饶，我会给你留个全尸的。”
乔乔奄奄一息的说道：“少爷……别……别管我，你你你快走，他他是个疯子……”
“走？”
“他走的了吗？”龙大耀自信的说道。
龙飞双拳一收，说道：“既然你是魔宗的人，那我也就没有必要顾忌什么了。”
说话间。
他右手一动，拿出开荒刀。
“哈哈哈……”
“区区黄品级的玄兵也好意思拿出来？”龙大耀嘲笑一声，也在这刹那间，他的身影一动，身体直接融入黑色煞气里面，转而冷冰冰的声音在山洞内响起，“龙飞，给我跪下！”
声音一落。
一只骷髅利爪突然抓向龙飞的脑门。

“开皮！”
开荒刀一动，龙飞一刀斩下去。
“叮！”
“积攒一层刀气！”
一刀抵挡住龙大耀的攻击，随后，龙飞速度如电，锁定龙大耀的身体，连续出刀，“断筋，裂骨，斩血，神开，惊魂，破杀……”
每次出刀，系统就会响起一道提示音。
提示刀气的积攒数量。
屠龙刀法释放出来，每一刀都是极其凶残，龙大耀的黑色煞气在第三刀之后完全被龙飞的开荒刀给震碎掉。后四刀更是将他逼到角落，发髻散落，全身都是刀痕，就像要被大卸八块一样，无比的狼狈。
也在此时。
山洞外传来龙战武愤怒的声音，“龙飞，我命令你立刻出来。”
龙傲也得意的大声喊道：“废物，出来受死吧，哈哈哈……”
“呜哈哈……”
龙大耀满头冷汗，完全没有想到龙飞已经厉害到这种程度了，才半年时间，转变的太快了。
他八级战师的修为竟然不是对手。
龙飞修炼的两种功法威力太强悍了，从来没有见过，特别是后面的刀法，抵挡三刀已经是极限。
后面四刀更是劈斩在他的灵魂上一样，无比的难受。
听到龙战武的声音之后，他立刻兴奋起来，大声喊道：“大长老，龙飞发疯了，他要杀我，快来救我啊。”
“快进来救我啊。”
龙大耀得意的对龙飞说道：“龙飞，就你也想杀我？哈哈哈……等下龙战武进来，他只会看到你要杀我，根本不会知道我是魔宗的人。你会死在他的掌下，要知道在龙家最想要你，命的人是他，哈哈哈……”
“你一死，我的目的也就达到了。”

“哈哈哈……”
“你刚才的那套刀法已经打完，再打一套，根本没时间，哈哈哈……龙飞，杀我？你也配，哈哈哈……”
一切都在他的算计中一样。
龙大耀得意的笑，在他看来，龙飞根本杀不了他。
龙战武也不会知道他是魔宗，击杀龙家总管可不是小罪，加上龙家上下对龙飞嗤之以鼻，绝对不会轻饶。

content_en:
Long Dayao moved his hands and attacked with a punch.
"Hoo, ho..."
The fist generated wind, and all the power of the eighth-level warrior exploded.
Long Fei was not afraid. He threw his body and turned into a big toad lying on the ground. He released his ten power, and the energy in his body rolled up and bounced away like air waves.
A movement of limbs.
"Buzz!"
The body bounced out, and the black shadow was like lightning, cutting through everything and rushing towards Long Dayao.
At the same time.
The true energy in his body stirred up.
"Hmph!"
"Trash is trash. I haven't seen you for half a year, and you are still trash. You still want to fight with me and seek death!" Long Dayao sneered and raised his fists into palms.
Shot out of the void.
The two forces formed a force and pounced on Long Fei.
"Bang, bang!"
Long Fei resisted hard and directly broke through the two forces, hitting Long Dayao hard in the abdomen.
Long Dayao resisted with all his strength with both hands.
"Strangulation!"
The power of the Toad Kung Fu suddenly changed dramatically and entered Long Dayao's body in a spiral-like rotation. Long Fei also took advantage of the trend and flew back.
"Buzz!"
There was a dull crashing sound inside Long Dayao's body, his face secretly grimaced, showing an expression of pain, "What a god-level skill?"
"Pfft..."
He spat out a mouthful of black blood, and the cold expression on his face became even more ferocious.
Long Fei sneered: "It's cool!"
"Bitch, do you think you are my opponent after practicing god-level skills?" Long Dayao's voice suddenly changed, and a black evil aura spread out from his body.
"Magic power?"
"Are you from the Demon Sect?" Long Fei was shocked. He finally knew why Long Dayao was spying on him and had been looking for him.
He began to think that this was Long Zhanwu's arrangement.
Now it seems that is not the case at all. This Long Dayao must be from the evil demon sect lurking in the Long family. Why did he arrest him?
As for this, Long Fei hasn't figured it out yet.
Long Dayao laughed gloomily and said: "As expected of the former genius of the Long family, he has some knowledge. Now you are afraid. Kneel down and kowtow to beg for mercy. I will leave a whole body for you."
Qiao Qiao said as he was dying: "Young master...don't...leave me alone, you, you, you, go away, he is a madman..."
"Go?"
"Did he leave?" Long Dayao said confidently.
Long Fei closed his fists and said, "Since you are from the Demon Sect, I don't have to worry about anything."
While talking.
He moved his right hand and took out the land reclamation knife.
"Hahaha..."
"How dare you bring out a mere yellow-level Xuanbing?" Long Dayao sneered. At that moment, his figure moved and his body merged directly into the black evil spirit. Then a cold voice sounded in the cave, "Long Fei, kneel down!"
The voice fell.
A skeleton claw suddenly grabbed Long Fei's forehead.
"Open the skin!"
As soon as the land reclamation knife moved, Long Fei slashed it down.
"Ding!"
"Accumulate a level of sword energy!"
The sword resisted Long Dayao's attack. Then, Long Fei was as fast as lightning, locked onto Long Dayao's body, and fired the sword continuously, "breaking tendons, cracking bones, cutting blood, divine opening, shocking, breaking and killing..."
Every time the knife is drawn, the system will sound a beep.
Prompts the accumulated amount of sword energy.
The dragon-slaying sword technique was unleashed, and each blow was extremely cruel. Long Dayao's black evil aura was completely shattered by Long Fei's land-clearing knife after the third blow. The last four knives forced him into a corner. His hair was scattered and his whole body was covered with knife marks. It was as if he was about to be torn into pieces. He was extremely embarrassed.
Also at this time.
Long Zhanwu's angry voice came from outside the cave, "Long Fei, I order you to come out immediately."
Long Ao also shouted proudly: "Trash, come out and die, hahaha..."
"Uuhaha..."
Long Dayao was covered in cold sweat. He had no idea that Long Fei had become so powerful. In just half a year, he had changed so quickly.
His cultivation as an eighth-level warrior was no match for him.
The two techniques practiced by Long Fei are too powerful.It's so powerful, I've never seen it before, especially the sword skills at the back. It's already the limit to withstand three swords.
The next four knives were like slashing into his soul, which was extremely painful.
After hearing Long Zhanwu's voice, he immediately became excited and shouted loudly: "Great Elder, Long Fei is crazy. He wants to kill me. Come and save me."
"Come in and save me."
Long Dayao proudly said to Long Fei: "Long Fei, you also want to kill me? Hahaha... When Long Zhanwu comes in, he will only see that you want to kill me, and will not know that I am a member of the Demon Sect. You will die in his hands. You must know that the person who wants your life most in the Long family is him, hahaha..."
"As soon as you die, my goal will be achieved."
"Hahaha..."
"You have already finished the set of sword skills you just used. You don't have time to do another set. Hahaha... Long Fei, kill me? You deserve it, hahaha..."
Everything is in his calculation.
Long Dayao smiled proudly. In his opinion, Long Fei couldn't kill him at all.
Long Zhanwu would not know that he was a demon sect. Killing the head of the Long family was not a small crime. In addition, the entire Long family despised Long Fei and would never let him go lightly.
